V_in.data_reference: definitional; upstream membrane potential supplied in a network; -70 mV (the SN resting potential) when unconnected

d.data_reference: definitional; varicosity diameter of the sphere of the model volume: d = (6 Vol/pi)^(1/3) with Vol = 1 um^3, the previous volume parameter (bennet1998Sympathetic, as cited in SN_simple) **Kept on review 2026-10-05 (from the model volume 1 um^3); luff1988form (serial EM of sympathetic postganglionic varicosities): small 0.5-1.0 um, large > 1 um diameter**

k_A.data_reference: definitional; area shape factor A = k_A d^2 of a sphere, pi

k_V.data_reference: definitional; volume shape factor V = k_V d^3 of a sphere, pi/6 (to double precision; the last bit is chosen so that Vol reproduces the previous value where a float allows)
